# Help with your appointment

Most questions are answered in the [frequently asked questions](https://harbor.example/help/faq).

If you still need help, [Contact support](https://harbor.example/support/contact) and an adviser
will reply within one working day.

For urgent medical help, call your local emergency number. Harbor Help is not an
emergency service.

The address of the help pages is set in `site.yaml`:

```yaml
help_url: https://harbor.example/help
```
